quotes.speaker: Brayden Burries
quotes.summary_phrase: Brayden Burries on his rebounding and offensive role
quotes.excerpt: The best thing is when I'm rebounding. So when I'm trying to rebound and getting those offensive rebounds
quotes.quote: The best thing is when I'm rebounding. So when I'm trying to rebound and getting those offensive rebounds especially, get the kick out threes. I feel like that's what I'm trying to do on the offensive end. And defensive end, like I said, just trying to rebound, defend. Didn't really do that today, but I can get better at it.
quotes.social_post: Brayden Burries says his offensive focus is on crashing the glass to create opportunities for others. He wants to focus on getting offensive rebounds and finding shooters for kick out threes.

quotes.speaker: Brayden Burries
quotes.summary_phrase: Taylor's specific development goals for Brayden Burries
quotes.excerpt: Just trying to get in the paint on offense and then defense help collapsing, kick outs
quotes.quote: Just trying to get in the paint on offense and then defense help collapsing, kick outs. You know, and then on defense side, picking up and then guarding like full court and stuff.
quotes.social_post: Brayden Burries outlines his development goals with the Bucks, focusing on getting into the paint on offense and picking up opposing guards full court on the defensive end.

quotes.speaker: Brayden Burries
quotes.summary_phrase: Brayden Burries on guarding elite NBA guards
quotes.excerpt: I think that's the best thing for me, honestly, just getting thrown in the fire.
quotes.quote: I think that's the best thing for me, honestly, just getting thrown in the fire. Started like that in high school and then college with playing Florida and then here just playing some of the best guards in the league. So me just checking in, guarding them right away, like if I can hold my own against them, then I should be pretty good.
quotes.social_post: Brayden Burries embraces the challenge of guarding elite NBA guards early in his career. He believes that if he can hold his own against the best in the league, he will be in a good spot.

quotes.speaker: Brayden Burries
quotes.summary_phrase: How scrimmaging translates to NBA game performance
quotes.excerpt: Just playing a lot of doing a lot of scrimmaging, you know, playing a lot of five-on-five
quotes.quote: Just playing a lot of doing a lot of scrimmaging, you know, playing a lot of five-on-five we do and some of our breakdown drills on defensive side, you know, helps me. And then yeah, just staying in the gym, just getting better each and every day. That's the main thing. At the end of the day, just ask myself, did I get better? And if I did, then I'm on a step in the right direction.
quotes.social_post: Brayden Burries credits the Bucks' heavy emphasis on five on five scrimmaging and defensive breakdown drills for helping him adjust to the speed of the NBA game.

quotes.speaker: Brayden Burries
quotes.summary_phrase: The unique veteran and youth dynamic on the Bucks
quotes.excerpt: We have a very unique team. We have a lot of young guys, some older guys
quotes.quote: We have a very unique team. We have a lot of young guys, some older guys, some guys right in the middle. So like we got different like we got a lot of leadership on this team, some vets, you know, some young guys that's coming in with me like Nate, you know, so feeling like I can even today like after the game talking to Ryan about stuff, you know, just little things. So I feel like that's pretty cool and like it's a blessing to have on the team.
quotes.social_post: Brayden Burries highlights the unique locker room dynamic in Milwaukee, noting the value of having a mix of veterans and young players to learn from as he navigates his rookie season.

quotes.speaker: Brayden Burries
quotes.summary_phrase: Brayden Burries on his primary postgame takeaway
quotes.excerpt: We just got to get better. That's the main thing. That's always the main thing
quotes.quote: We just got to get better. That's the main thing. That's always the main thing is just getting better and then for me though, probably be like taking care of the ball, better at that. But yeah, the fitting, we got to rebound better and I feel like we'll be good.
quotes.social_post: Brayden Burries identifies ball security and rebounding as the two primary areas for improvement following the latest game, stating we just got to get better.
